subject: [PATCH v8 24/30] mm/khugepaged: treat PMD swap entries as mapped THPs

2026-10-02.patch_summary: This patch modifies the khugepaged code to treat PMD swap entries as mapped THPs, allowing them to be handled similarly to present huge PMDs. This change affects how MADV_COLLAPSE handles swapped-out THPs, ensuring that they are still collapsed into a single THP on first touch. The approach taken is to add a new condition in the check_pmd_state function to return SCAN_PMD_MAPPED for PMD swap entries.
